subject: Phase 100364: clio mcp http Auto-Bind and 34300-34309 Port Scan
verdict_justification: The auto-bind port scan, CLI flags, address announcement, and security guards function as specified. However, the modified parse_flags loop introduces a Clippy while_let_loop lint error that breaks `make lint`, and explicit-address unit/harness tests suffer from intermittent port-reuse race conditions under parallel execution.

issues.title: Clippy while_let_loop compilation error fails `make lint`
issues.why_it_matters: `make lint` runs `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`. Clippy generates an error on the new parse_flags loop in main.rs, causing make lint to fail with exit code 101. The developer claimed clippy was clean in §9 and the run log.
issues.impact: CI gate failure; repository does not pass make lint or make check.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103:5: error: this loop could be written as a `while let` loop
issues.proposed_fix: In crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103, replace `loop { let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next()) else { break; }; ... }` with `while let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next()) { ... }`.

issues.title: Racy port allocation in `explicit_address_is_honored` causes intermittent test failure during coverage run
issues.why_it_matters: The unit test binds to port 0, reads the assigned port, drops the listener, and immediately re-binds. If the socket lingers in TIME_WAIT or a parallel test thread binds the port, resolve_listener fails with AddrInUse (code 48).
issues.impact: Flaky test runs in CI and coverage gates (`make coverage` failed on the first run with 'bind explicit: Os { code: 48, kind: AddrInUse }').
issues.proposed_fix: Add a bounded retry loop when selecting and verifying an explicit port in http_bind_tests.rs and mcp_http_bind_harness.rs, similar to occupied_with_free_next().

issues.title: CLI flag parser does not support `--bind=HOST:PORT` syntax and silently falls back to auto-bind
issues.why_it_matters: When a user passes `--bind=127.0.0.1:34305`, `parse_flags` does not split on `=` and stores key `bind=127.0.0.1:34305`. `flags.get("bind")` returns None, causing clio to silently auto-bind to 34300 instead of 34305.
issues.impact: Users passing standard `--flag=value` syntax receive no warning/error and are bound to an unexpected port.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:108: `target/debug/clio mcp http --bind=127.0.0.1:34305 --db sqlite::memory:` outputs 'mcp http listening on 127.0.0.1:34300'
issues.proposed_fix: In parse_flags, check if flag contains `=` (e.g. `flag.split_once('=')`) or reject unrecognized flag tokens.

findings.title: Racy port allocation in `explicit_address_is_honored` causes intermittent test failure during coverage run
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/http_bind_tests.rs:35:62: `make coverage` failed with 'bind explicit: Os { code: 48, kind: AddrInUse, message: "Address already in use" }'
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded retry loop for explicit port selection in http_bind_tests.rs and mcp_http_bind_harness.rs so tests do not flake when dropped probe sockets linger in TIME_WAIT.

findings.title: CLI flag parser does not support `--bind=HOST:PORT` syntax and silently falls back to auto-bind
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:108: `clio mcp http --bind=127.0.0.1:34305 --db sqlite::memory:` binds to 127.0.0.1:34300 instead of 34305
findings.recommendation: In parse_flags, parse `--flag=value` by splitting on `=` or reject unexpected `--` tokens.

strengths: Clean decomposition: http_bind module is concise (79 lines) with truthful AGENTS.md header and well-bounded ownership.
Strict adherence to security rules: non-loopback addresses fail closed without an auth token before listener announcement.
Zero stdout pollution: stderr receives diagnostic/announcement logs while stdout carries 0 bytes on startup.
Shared constants: range 34300-34309 cleanly reuses port_scan::FIRST_PORT and LAST_PORT.
regrets: Developer claimed cargo clippy was clean without running with -D warnings or --all-targets.
Integration and unit test probe-and-rebind patterns should have used retry loops to prevent flaky failures.
process_changes: Always run `make lint` prior to declaring developer work done.
Guard ephemeral socket tests against TIME_WAIT reuse collisions.
plan_1hr: Change the loop in crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:103 to `while let Some(flag) = pending.take().or_else(|| it.next())` to fix `make lint`.

plan_unlimited: Enhance `parse_flags` to robustly handle `--key=val` pairs and report usage errors on unrecognized flags.
Unify socket test helpers into a shared test utility module.
